description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

About the job

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

In this role, you'll be...

Your responsibilities:


Design and implement initiatives to acquire new drivers, being able to leverage data for the decision making process.
Manage the launch and execution of incentives, projects, communications and product developments needed for driver acquisition, ensuring efficiency and expansion.
Be primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, managing expectations and prioritizing operations to deliver results, whilst constantly working along cross-functional teams (Marketing, Legal, City Operations, Product, etc).
Define and manage data dashboards to monitor national performance of driver acquisition and our results.
Ownership of driver acquisition incentives, across multiple countries in Spanish Speaking LatAm.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The successful applicant:


Bachelor's Degree: Engineering, Data Science, Actuary or any related field.
Growth / Marketplace experience: Experimental Testing, User Acquisition, Conversion, Habit Loops, PMF, GTM, Communication Strategies, Marketplace Balance, Pricing, etc
Resilient: proven to be self-motivated, self-directed, and eager to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
User Centric: understanding the needs, motivation and detractors of ride-hailing Drivers to link with our Value Proposition.
Problem Solver with unique strength towards identifying bottlenecks and coming up with creative solutions.
Data-driven core: passion for data analytics and programming, with knowledge/experience in SQL (Nice to have: Python, R, etc.). Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets) are a must. Comfortable about learning and using new software tools.
Effective communication skills. Proficiency in English & Spanish. We're an international team!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Associate, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimization of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts in your assigned territory. You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimize their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Market Associate, you will be responsible for the retention and growth of small and medium hosts in an assigned territory. You will establish and nurture business relationships with emerging professional host accounts by suggesting and supporting strategic initiatives that drive their success on Airbnb. These initiatives will include supply optimization, pricing optimization, host recruitment, and platform education. In addition, as these Hosts successfully grow on the platform, it will be imperative that you help them maintain best-in-class hospitality standards for an excellent guest experience. Beyond one-to-one account management responsibilities, you’ll also support Market Managers on your team to deliver one-to-many education programs, such as webinars and scaled e-mail communication. Ultimately, this team will be responsible for helping long-tail Hosts thrive on Airbnb.

A Typical Day


Manage a book of business consisting of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts, ensuring their retention, growth, and optimization on Airbnb.
Conduct one-on-one optimization and onboarding conversations, providing strategic recommendations on pricing, availability, and listing quality.
Secure availability over high compression dates, ensuring hosts maximize their revenue potential.
Educate hosts on product updates and policy changes, while channeling their feedback to internal teams.
Respond to host inquiries and provide timely, high-quality support to improve their experience on the platform.
Analyze performance data to identify trends and take action on opportunities that drive increased bookings and host success.
Develop long-lasting relationships with hosts, ensuring they receive ongoing support tailored to their needs.


Your Expertise


3+ years of experience in new sales, account management, or partner support.
2+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have).
Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively.
Proven experience working a book of business, driving engagement and growth through proactive account management.
Highly goal-driven, with a strong bias for action and persistence in the face of challenges.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively via phone, email, and in-person.
Proficiency in CRM tools, particularly working with leads and opportunities (Salesforce experience is a plus).
Fluency in English and Spanish.


Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is monthly, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Mexico Monthly Pay Range

$43,500—$48,333 MXN

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives.



Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.





Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.





We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com





Job Description



This role is key to driving business growth in Mexico, supporting the Regional Business Generation team and aligning with Turner & Townsend’s global strategy, brand ambition, and values. The position combines strategic marketing, client development, and bid management, ensuring a strong pipeline of opportunities and increased win rates.



Key Responsibilities



Business Generation & Marketing



Support and co-develop key client account plans alongside Country leadership and Key Account Managers
Contribute to new client pursuit strategies and sector expansion initiatives
Conduct market and client research, translating insights into actionable business opportunities
Maintain and enhance marketing materials (case studies, capability statements, presentations)

Client & Account Management



Coordinate and support client meetings and presentations
Drive client care programs and ensure feedback is captured and leveraged
Challenge account strategies to identify new revenue streams and strengthen client relationships

Bid & Proposal Management



Support and coordinate bid processes following “Bid to Win” methodology
Prepare and review non-technical proposals, ensuring brand consistency and quality standards
Track and follow up on bids to improve conversion rates and outcomes

Reporting & Insights



Prepare monthly Business Generation reports, including key wins and pipeline updates
Support leadership reporting for management and board meetings
Ensure data and insights are effectively used to inform decision-making

Key Outcomes



Increased win rate and pipeline quality
Stronger client relationships and brand positioning
Expansion into new clients and market sectors
Enhanced data-driven decision-making and reporting


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
+3 years of experience in Business Development, Marketing, or similar roles
Experience in consulting, construction, or project management environments (preferred)
Fluency in English and Spanish
Strong communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills

About the job

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

In the Content Creator (Copy) position you’ll be responsible for developing the social content.

This role provides a huge opportunity to redefine the category and create content that truly has impact. As a social-first creative you’ll need to craft ideas that demonstrate cultural relevance and will be responsible for the daily management of the local community and moderation of our brand's social channels, ensuring that our content resonates with local audiences and meets their needs.

In This Role You Will



Develop and execute creative and engaging social media strategies in collaboration with strategy, creative teams and technology AI teams. 
Manage the day-to-day handling of social media content across channels including Instagram and TikTok adapting content to suit different channels.
Spot social opportunities within wider creative ideas.
Use AI tools to propose and create social content.
Develop a monthly social editorial calendar and align with the wider content team.
Create content in-the-moment in response to social trends.
Ensure legal compliance of content (e.g. copyright and data protection).
Develop innovative creative in response to client briefs, alongside identifying proactive opportunities to develop social content that will fulfill the brand objectives.
Present ideas comprehensively to clients and colleagues, confidently explaining and supporting your thinking.
Amend and redevelop content in response to feedback.
Understand performance metrics, and use them to inform future creative development.
Be responsible for the full creative funnel, from ideation to creation of social content.
Understand social platforms and trends in real time to trigger new ideas and proposals for campaigns.



Experience You Already Have



A social native, active across a multitude of platforms.
Demonstrate passion for socially-led creative thinking.
2+ years of proven work experience as a social-first creative for an agency / brand.
Experience of developing exciting social executions for brands.
Basic experience in the use of AI tools for creating scripts and visual content.
A keen eye on emerging social trends across platforms
Experience of crafting reactive content in response to social trends.
Experience working on brave, innovative brands, looking to push cultural boundaries.
A keen eye for visual details and accuracy.
A deep understanding of consumer behaviour, and adapting content plans to address the needs of the community.
Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
A great team player, that can work hand to hand with tech areas.
Experience of basic camera work, editing and design is a bonus.



About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

Collaborate with content, product marketing, design, and engineering to improve messaging, information architecture, and technical implementation.
Present SEO and GEO performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to marketing leadership.

Experience with AI-visibility platforms such as Otterly, Profound, or similar tools.
Practical GEO/AEO experience, including optimizing content for AI Overviews or LLM citations and demonstrating measurable results.
Strong understanding of content optimization, keyword research, information architecture, and internal linking.
A data-driven approach to identifying and prioritizing SEO opportunities, with the ability to connect organic performance to paying customers rather than focusing solely on traffic.
Experience working cross-functionally with content, product marketing, analytics, design, and engineering teams.
Strong communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders and clearly present strategic recommendations.
Analytical and structured approach to problem-solving, with a strong focus on measurable outcomes.
English proficiency at B2 level or higher for effective professional communication.

Tu responsabilidad principal será explicar conceptos con claridad, relacionarlos con la práctica y acompañar a los participantes mientras desarrollan proyectos y soluciones con propósito. Trabajarás en coordinación con Tutores y Facilitadores. La Dirección de Academia y de Innovación Educativa te capacitará y proporcionará los materiales de cada experiencia.




¿Qué harás?

Prepararte con los contenidos y materiales de cada sesión.
Conducir explicaciones, actividades y conversaciones que inviten a participar.
Adaptar tus explicaciones a los distintos niveles de experiencia del grupo.

Capacidad para explicar conceptos de manera sencilla y conectar la teoría con ejemplos y actividades prácticas.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de identificar y contactar empresas objetivo, abrir conversaciones con tomadores de decisión, calificar oportunidades y agendar reuniones comerciales para el equipo, manteniendo una gestión ordenada y precisa del pipeline en CRM.

LO QUE BUSCAMOS EN NUESTRO/A CANDIDATO/A IDEAL:

1. A partir de 2+ años de experiencia en roles de prospección comercial, generación de leads outbound o desarrollo de ventas B2B. 

2. Experiencia deseable en sectores como tecnología B2B, SaaS, Fintech, contact center, CPaaS, cloud communications, soluciones digitales o servicios tecnológicos para empresas. 

3. Experiencia previa como Representante Comercial, Ejecutivo Comercial, SDR, BDR, Sales Development, Lead Generation o posiciones similares.

4. Mentalidad hunter y fuerte orientación a resultados, con comodidad para hacer contacto en frío, buscar nuevos prospectos y abrir puertas con tomadores de decisión. 

5. Capacidad para identificar empresas objetivo, entender el perfil de cliente ideal y calificar oportunidades comerciales de manera estructurada. 

6. Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar soluciones tecnológicas de forma clara, consultiva y profesional. 

7. Experiencia trabajando con CRM, registrando actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de oportunidades de manera ordenada y constante. 

8. Perfil organizado, proactivo, coachable y con actitud madura para representar a la empresa en primeras conversaciones comerciales y eventos de la industria. 

9. Inglés intermedio, suficiente para comunicarse con equipo internacional y entender información comercial del producto. 

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES DEL PUESTO:

1) Realizar prospección outbound a empresas objetivo definidas por la compañía. 

2) Contactar a prospectos a través de canales como LinkedIn, email, llamadas y otros medios comerciales. 

3) Representar a la empresa de manera profesional en eventos, conferencias y espacios de networking de la industria, realizando prospección activa y no solo atención pasiva de contactos.

4) Identificar y abrir conversaciones con los tomadores de decisión adecuados dentro de cada empresa. 

5) Calificar oportunidades comerciales, entendiendo las necesidades del prospecto, el fit con la solución y el potencial de negocio. 

6) Mantener información clara, completa y actualizada en el CRM sobre actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de cada cuenta. 

7) Dar seguimiento constante a prospectos y oportunidades en etapa inicial del proceso comercial.

¿POR QUÉ UNIRTE A ESTE EQUIPO?

· La empresa ofrece un entorno dinámico, flexible y de baja burocracia, donde se valora la responsabilidad, la iniciativa, la transparencia, la capacidad de aprendizaje y la ejecución constante.




TRES CLAVES PARA EL ÉXITO EN ESTA POSICIÓN

1) Mentalidad hunter y fuerte capacidad de prospección outbound

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
skills: Lead and own the full lifecycle of services—from architecture and design through deployment, operations, and continuous optimization—ensuring scalability, reliability, and alignment with business objectives.
Analyze platform-level ITSM performance and proactively establish feedback loops with engineering teams, influencing roadmap prioritization to address systemic gaps and improve resiliency.

Define and drive production readiness standards, including operational design reviews, capacity planning, and launch governance, ensuring services meet reliability and scalability benchmarks before go-live.
Define and evolve monitoring frameworks for availability, latency, and system health, leveraging metrics and telemetry to proactively prevent incidents and improve service performance.
Champion automation-first principles to scale systems efficiently, reducing manual toil while improving deployment velocity and overall system reliability.
Lead the design and governance of CI/CD pipelines, implementing robust validation, operational gates, and best practices to drive consistency, quality, and speed across environments.
Drive best-in-class incident response practices, including rapid mitigation, stakeholder communication, and blameless postmortems, ensuring continuous improvement and resilience.
Take a holistic, system-wide approach during critical incidents, connect

Act as a technical leader and mentor, developing junior engineers, promoting best practices, and raising the overall bar for engineering excellence within the organization.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field (e.g., Physics, Mathematics), or equivalent practical experience.
8–15 years of relevant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure, or DevOps roles, with a combination of hands-on technical expertise and early leadership responsibilities.

Strong technical foundation across enterprise platforms, Linux/UNIX systems, operating systems, and database environments (Oracle/SQL, DBA), with the ability to provide technical guidance and support to the team.
Experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace), driving improved system visibility, performance, and reliability.
Solid experience in DevOps and CI/CD practices, with the ability to support and guide automation, deployment pipelines, and operational improvements.

Experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and performance optimization.
Strong program management capabilities, with a track record of successfully leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution.
Extensive experience working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritize initiatives, build strong partnerships, and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Practical knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably AWS, with familiarity in cloud-native architectures and operational best practices.
Ability to critically assess existing processes and challenge the status quo, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and overall business impact.

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead Site Reliability Engineer

Overview

The role of Business Operations Organization is to be the production readiness steward for Mastercard products. As a Business Operations we are responsible for ensuring that our platform is stable and healthy. We break down barriers to run our products by fostering developer run ownership and empowering developers to build resilient products. We support our developers during the application build phase in software run principals that includes operational design, automation, capacity planning, monitoring that leads to fault-tolerant, scalable products. We see the big picture and help create and enforce operations standards while facilitating an agile and learning culture.

We accomplish this transformation through supporting daily operations with a hyper focus on triage and then root cause by understanding the business impact of our products. The goal of every biz ops team is to shift left to be more proactive and upfront in the development process, and to proactively manage production and change activities to maximize customer experience and increase the overall value of supported applications. Biz Ops teams also focus on risk management by tying all our activities together with an overarching responsibility for compliance and risk mitigation across all our environments. A biz ops focus is also on streamlining and standardizing traditional application specific support activities and centralizing points of interaction for both internal and external partners by communicating effectively with all key stakeholders.

Ultimately, the role of biz ops is to align Product and Customer Focused priorities with Operational needs. We regularly review our run state not only from an internal perspective but also understanding and providing the feedback loop to our development partners on how we can improve the customer experience of our applications.

Key Responsibilities


 Lead and own the full lifecycle of services—from architecture and design through deployment, operations, and continuous optimization—ensuring scalability, reliability, and alignment with business objectives.

We are seeking site reliability engineers with an appetite for change and who can push the boundaries of what can be completed through automation, while managing service levels for some of Mastercard’s most critical security services.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

title: Lead Software Engineer AI (Staff Engineer)
skills: Shape the team's AI and patterns: Define patterns for building MCP servers, designing agents, novel uses of LLMs, experimentation, and scalable infrastructure. Your decisions will influence your product area and adjacent teams, not just a single feature.

Work at real production scale: Build and evolve systems that operate over millions of documents, highly structured tax data, ever-changing laws, and thousands of concurrent AI interactions from accountants doing time‑sensitive work.

Small teams, big surface area: Interact and lead across several teams of engineers, product, UX design and AI Labs partners to research, design and ship products quickly, with direct access to product leadership and customers.
Great fit for people who enjoy and thrive at setting technical direction, mentoring senior engineers, and spending most of their time in the code and architecture of AI systems.
Shape the platform integration strategy across new and existing Thomson Reuters audit systems to provide world-class content and solutions for our customers.
Lead multi‑quarter initiatives that cut across AI, product, and infra (e.g., a new orchestration layer, a low-latency retrieval system, or a unified knowledge base).
Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raising the bar on system design, code quality, and AI integration practices across the org.

Be a go-to expert in new model capabilities, collaborating closely with AI/ML engineers, researchers, designers, and PMs to translate industry improvements into reliable, user‑facing workflows that accountants trust.
Help shape the team’s roadmap, technical strategy, and engineering culture – from experimentation practices to testing, rollout, and postmortems.

Own the end-to-end architecture and design of backend services (C#/.NET, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Vercel) that integrate and orchestrate across heterogeneous systems and technology stacks, powering generative AI agents, complex workflows and document‑centric experiences.
Build and evolve AI orchestration: routing, tool calling, MCP servers, multi‑step workflows, safety and guardrails, and robust error handling around third‑party LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others).
Design for high‑throughput, low‑latency AI workloads: caching, queuing, rate‑limiting, model failover, and cost/performance trade-offs.
Work with large‑scale data: millions of documents, retrieval and search, vector stores, and indexing strategies tailored to tax and accounting use cases.
Establish and refine SLOs, observability, and incident response for AI systems that must be correct, auditable, and trustworthy in professional workflows.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
Proven track record of shipping production-grade AI systems to customers, including deployment, monitoring, evaluation, scaling, and ongoing operational ownership in enterprise environments.
Overall 10+ years cumulative experience with 2 years in a lead role and minimum 5+ years full-stack development, building scalable cloud-based applications, web services, APIs and AI-driven products.

C#/.NET expertise is a strong plus, though not mandatory. Alongside experience with production systems using frameworks like ASP.NET Core (or similar), relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent), and a major cloud provider (AWS preferred, Azure acceptable).
Experience architecting and implementing accessible front-end solutions, including: JavaScript, Typescript, HTML, CSS; experience with modern JavaScript frameworks, e.g., Angular, React, etc.
Strong background in distributed systems: data modeling, API contracts, observability, resilience patterns, and performance tuning under load.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner with product, design, and ML teams in a fast‑moving environment.
Demonstrated interest in AI systems and new engineering paradigms: LLMs, agents, retrieval, or similar – you care about what “AI‑native” software should look like.
Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines (i.e., GitHub Actions)
Hands‑on experience integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into production applications, including prompt/response management, cost controls, and safety considerations.
Experience with AI‑adjacent infrastructure: vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, or custom retrieval pipelines.
Opinions and experience around automated testing, reliability, and release practices for systems with non-deterministic model behavior.
Prior experience in domains where correctness, auditability, and compliance matter (fintech, tax, audit, legal, or similar), or strong interest in applying AI in those contexts.
Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About the job

Location: México

What We Can Achieve Together

The Finance Accounting Specialist provides specialized finance and accounting-related services to the Mexico, Belize, and Guatemala business units and is responsible for supporting the financial operations and compliance requirements of the local Civil Association in Mexico.

They provide specialized services in accounting, accounts payable, payroll, cash management, statutory compliance, and financial reporting. They provide support on short-term projects across the Business Units. They are an expert in their area of specialization. They administer and maintain finance/accounting activities in accordance with TNC policies and procedures and best practices in financial management. They apply independent judgment to resolve accounting and compliance matters, identify financial risks, and recommend solutions. The Finance Accounting Specialist builds effective partnerships with internal and external stakeholders. They use TNC´s code of conduct and competencies guide for their actions and to be an example for others.

They may supervise one or more team members and is responsible for providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, guidance, and performance support. The role helps foster an inclusive, collaborative, and service-oriented team culture by supporting employee development, encouraging continuous learning, promoting accountability, and recognizing contributions. We’re Looking For You

Have you ever asked yourself, “How can I make a difference?”, but you don’t know where to go or have the time to do it? Welcome to The Nature Conservancy!

You have found the solution and now you can make a difference every day! By joining our Finance and Operations team, you will become part of a group that is a force for nature and people. We´re looking for someone with strong experience in accounting/finance and experience working in a diverse, multi-disciplinary team. The ideal candidate will have exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience in accounting and finance. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to our mission of environmental conservation by supporting our Argentina and Chile business units. Come join TNC and apply today!

Job Family: Finance & Accounting

Internal Job Code: 700038

Salary Grade: 6

Who We Are

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to applyhelp@tnc.org with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

title: Senior Integration Developer (webMethods)
description:
About the job

Job Title: Senior Integration Developer (webMethods)

Location: Remote

Duration: 12 Months




Position Summary

The Integration Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting complex, high-volume integration solutions that connect shipboard systems (Property Management Systems, Point of Sale) with shoreside corporate applications (ERP, HRIS, CRM). You will leverage the Software AG webMethods suite to ensure seamless data flow across a hybrid cloud/on-premise environment.




Key Responsibilities

• Design & Development: Develop end-to-end integration flows using webMethods Integration Server, Designer, and Flow/Java services.

• Adapter Management: Configure and maintain various adapters including JDBC, Oracle, Salesforce, and Cloud Streams.

• B2B & EDI: Manage partner onboarding and document exchange using webMethods Trading Networks and EDI Module (X12, EDIFACT).

• API Management: Develop and expose REST/SOAP APIs to be consumed by web and mobile applications; manage security via API Gateway.

• Messaging: Implement asynchronous communication patterns using webMethods Broker or Universal Messaging (UM).

• Support & Optimization: Provide Tier 3 production support, troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, and manage server patches using Command Central.




Technical Requirements

• Core Suite: 5+ years of experience with webMethods 9.x/10.x (Integration Server, MWS, Trading Networks).

• Adapters: Extensive experience with Oracle Adapter and JDBC Adapter.

• Web Services: Deep knowledge of REST, JSON, SOAP, and WSDL.

• DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Bitbucket, and webMethods Deployer.

• Database: Strong SQL skills for querying and troubleshooting backend databases (SQL Server/Oracle).

• Cloud: Familiarity with integrating on-prem systems with AWS or Azure services.




Must Have:

• webMethods Integration Server / Trading Networks / MWS

• webMethods Flow & Java Services Development

• EDI (X12 / EDIFACT) & B2B Integration

• REST / SOAP APIs (JSON, WSDL)

• webMethods Adapters (Oracle / JDBC)

• Messaging (Broker / Universal Messaging - UM)

• CI/CD & DevOps (Jenkins, Bitbucket, webMethods Deployer)







Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in the Travel/Cruise/Hospitality industry.

• Certifications in Software AG webMethods or Integration Architecture.

About the job

Cleaned Document

About The Role And Team

Community Operations at Uber is where real people solve real problems in real time. As a Greenlight Expert, you are the face of Uber for the drivers and earners who keep our world moving. Operating out of our in-person Greenlight hubs, you'll help new partners get on the road for the first time and support existing ones in finding greater success on the platform. This isn't a typical retail or desk job; it's a high-energy, front-facing role where you bridge the gap between our digital platform and the physical world.

The pace is intense, and the stakes are high-you'll often be the first person a driver speaks to when they have a problem or a breakthrough. You'll need to stay calm under pressure, balance empathy with action, and make fast decisions that help our partners move forward with confidence. If you're sharp, steady, and motivated by providing meaningful service at a local scale, this is where you'll grow.

What You'll Do


 Support riders, drivers, couriers, and merchants during critical moments-helping turn uncertainty into clarity through empathy, speed, and sound judgment. 
 Facilitate driver sign-ups by communicating the real-world value of the Uber platform, navigating them through the onboarding process with both urgency and care. 
 Make fast, thoughtful decisions in real-time to resolve front-facing customer issues, ensuring every person walks out with a clear path forward. 
 Communicate with care and professionalism, even in emotionally charged situations, ensuring drivers feel heard and supported in every interaction. 
 Identify patterns and escalate technical or procedural blockers to management, contributing to how we improve the in-person support experience over time. 
 Collaborate with teammates to execute local events and promotions, acting as a brand ambassador to build engagement within your city's earner community. 
 Learn and grow in an environment that challenges you to stay sharp, troubleshoot technical issues on the fly, and show up with intention every day. 


 Basic Qualifications 


 Experience in a retail, hospitality, or customer service environment where you handled high-volume, face-to-face interactions. 
 Proficiency in basic computer skills and the ability to learn new technical tools quickly. 
 Proven communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to explain complex processes clearly. 
 Must be able to work from the designated Greenlight location with a commitment to punctuality. 


 Preferred Qualifications 


 Proven ability to stay calm and empathetic in emotionally charged or high-pressure, face-to-face situations. 
 Strong conflict resolution skills with the ability to navigate difficult conversations with clarity and care. 
 Experience in public speaking or presenting to diverse groups of people. 
 A "go-get-it" attitude and a commitment to delivering excellence as the face of Uber in your local community. 


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. About Us - Malvern Panalytical, Micromeritics And SciAps.

Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.

We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.

Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.

Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. Our leading technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity.

SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.

We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are more than 2,500 employees in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, all committed to delivering expert and responsive customer support.

We are part of Spectris. Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. Precision is at the heart of what we do – our leading, high-tech instruments and software equip our customers to solve some of their greatest challenges to make the world cleaner, healthier and more productive.

UAE company formation

Corporate bank account assistance
Corporate Tax and VAT

Ongoing corporate support

Your job is to start conversations, understand whether there is a genuine business opportunity, create interest in the UAE, and schedule qualified meetings with our consultants.

You will contact:

Business owners

Accountants and accounting firms
Lawyers and corporate law firms
Tax consultants
Company formation consultants
Immigration/business consultants
Wealth and financial advisers
International business professionals

Identify prospects interested in establishing or expanding into the UAE
Identify potential referral and strategic partners
Ask qualification questions

Maintain accurate notes and call outcomes

Native or near-native Spanish
Strong spoken communication skills
Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, SDR, telesales or outbound sales experience
Confidence speaking with business owners and professionals
Ability to sound professional rather than reading mechanically from a script
Good objection-handling skills
Strong follow-up discipline

International business

title: Event Marketing Manager | FinTech, Crypto & Strategic B2B Events
description:
About the job

For our client, an international technology company that is strengthening its commercial and marketing presence in Mexico and LATAM, we are looking for a proactive and highly organized Event Marketing Manager.




We are looking for a proactive, hands-on and highly organized Event Marketing Manager who can take ownership of event activities in Mexico, from identifying the right opportunities and managing local vendors to lead capture, CRM follow-up and post-event performance analysis.

This is not a purely operational event-planning role.




The main goal of this role is to make events a measurable commercial channel by supporting brand awareness, generating qualified leads, contributing to SQL and pipeline creation, and connecting event participation with clear business outcomes.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR IN OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

· We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of event execution in Mexico and manage multiple details, vendors, deadlines, and internal stakeholders at the same time.

· The ideal candidate should have solid experience organizing corporate, B2B marketing events and should understand that events are not only about logistis, but also about brand visibility, lead generation, CRM follow-up, and business impact.

 

EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING SECTORS WOULD BE HIGHLY VALUABLE:

B2B technology; Crypto, SaaS; FinTech; banking technology; telecom; CPaaS; cloud communications; contact center technology; enterprise software; digital B2B services; corporate event agencies serving technology or business clients. 

1. Experience in event management, event marketing, field marketing, corporate events, B2B events. 

2. Previous experience organizing business-focused events such as conferences, trade shows, expos, sponsored events, business lunches, executive dinners, roundtables, or partner events. 

3. Strong experience coordinating local vendors, including venues, production teams, booth builders, printing suppliers, merchandise providers, catering providers, and logistics partners. 

4. Ability to manage event timelines, budgets, materials, approvals, deadlines, and several event-related workstreams simultaneously. 

5. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through. 

6. Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. 

7. Ability to work independently, anticipate risks, and proactively follow up on open tasks. 

8. Fluent Spanish for local coordination with vendors, venues, and partners in Mexico + Strong business English for communication with the direct manager and international teams. 

9. Based in Mexico, ideally in Mexico City or nearby. 

10. Availability to travel when required for events.

 

MAIN JOB FUNCTIONS

1. Develop and regularly update the annual event calendar for Mexico and LATAM prioritizing activities based on ICP fit, brand relevance, and commercial potential. 

2. Identify and evaluate relevant conferences, summits, trade shows, business events, executive dinners, roundtables, sponsorships, and co-hosted event opportunities. 

3. Coordinate the company’s participation in events from end to end, including planning, budgeting, logistics, vendor management, booth or brand zone preparation, materials, merchandise, and onsite execution. 

4. Manage local vendors and partners in Mexico, including booth builders, production teams, venues, catering providers, printing suppliers, merchandising providers, logistics partners, and event agencies. 

5. Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, PR, and regional teams to ensure that each event is aligned with commercial priorities, target accounts, product messaging, and marketing goals. 

6. Support lead generation during events by helping the Sales team collect, organize, and qualify leads through badge scanning, forms, meetings, demos, networking activities, and other lead capture methods. 

7. Ensure proper synchronization of event leads with the company’s CRM, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems, including accurate tagging, data quality, lead ownership, and follow-up visibility. 

8. Coordinate post-event follow-up activities together with Sales, Content, and Product Marketing teams, including email campaigns, social media coverage, PR materials, presentations, and nurture flows. 

9. Support the organization of smaller high-value event formats, such as executive dinners, business lunches, partner events, roundtables, and co-branded activities. 

10. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports, analyzing KPIs such as MQLs, SQLs, CPL, conversion rate, meetings generated, pipeline contribution, ARR potential, branded traffic, media mentions, and overall ROI. 

 

Why Join This Team?

1. This is a great opportunity to join an international B2B technology company expanding in Mexico and LATAM, with a highly attractive compensation package, a mostly remote work format, and the opportunity to travel for key events and conferences.

2. You will take real ownership of event marketing activities in Mexico, working on high-impact initiatives that go beyond logistics and directly support brand visibility, qualified lead generation, pipeline contribution, and business growth.

3. The role offers strong exposure to cloud communications, CPaaS, contact center solutions, and customer engagement technologies, while collaborating with international Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and regional teams.

4. You will join a supportive, collaborative, and non-toxic environment where responsibility, initiative, learning, and ownership are valued. You will also receive guidance from an experienced manager and regional event team, while having the freedom to bring ideas, improve processes, test new event formats, and help build a stronger event marketing function in Mexico.

 

Three Keys to Success in This Position

 

 Ownership, responsibility, and strong execution discipline

 Strong local execution and vendor management in Mexico

 Business-oriented event marketing mindset

 

If you are proactive, highly organized, and excited about building impactful B2B event marketing activities in Mexico, we would be very happy to meet you. Please send your CV to this email cv@tk-recruitment.com we would love to learn more about you.

skills: Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.

Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.

You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.

You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.


You are a fit if


You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.

This matters as much as anything else on this list.

Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.


You are not a fit if


"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.


Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

title: Paid Search Strategist, DTC eCommerce (Remote)
location: Gustavo A. Madero, Mexico City, Mexico (Remote)
skills: Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.

Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.

You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.

You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
description:
About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like


Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.


You are a fit if


You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.


You are not a fit if


"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.


Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.
