The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like


Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt


You are a fit if


You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too


You are not a fit if


"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed
You want to be told what to do this week
You need a ticketing system to know what matters
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question


Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

skills: Content Planning: develop and oversee content calendars, campaigns, and deliverables, ensuring strategic consistency, quality, and attention to detail throughout the process.
Organic Growth Strategy: develop strategies to increase the reach, relevance, and engagement of brand channels and creator profiles, building active communities over time.

Team Guidance: work along the Creative team and Community Managers, ensuring their efforts align with strategic objectives.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills across multidisciplinary teams.
Familiarity with social media management, analytics, and social listening tools.
Experience integrating AI into strategic workflows, with the curiosity and judgment to explore new applications as the technology evolves.
Background in Marketing, Communications or related fields.
3 years of proven experience in social media strategy or a related role.
Demonstrated success in developing and implementing social media strategies that drive engagement and meet business objectives.
A background in fashion and/or beauty is preferred.

Mission is a platform for hiring, vetting and managing software development talents. It enables our clients to connect with the world’s best talent to build mission-critical software products.




About the Company

This enterprise software company provides an AI platform designed to automate complex operations such as demand forecasting and supply chain optimization. The platform bridges the gap between experimental pilots and production-ready workflows, enabling organizations in global industries to deploy scalable AI solutions. By focusing on governed intelligence and data integration, the company helps businesses achieve operational efficiency through an interface for building and managing production-grade AI applications at scale.




About the Role

As a software engineer, you will design and own production systems end-to-end, focusing on the infrastructure required to operationalize machine learning models. You will be responsible for building the scalable APIs, microservices, and data pipelines that support reliable AI applications. Rather than focusing on model training, your impact lies in shipping the robust systems that surround these models, ensuring high performance, fault tolerance, and observability at scale. You will act as the primary bridge between core backend engineering and machine learning deployment.




What You'll Do

Design and maintain scalable APIs and microservices to support high-throughput production environments.
Build robust data pipelines for model ingestion and processing using SQL and NoSQL databases.
Deploy machine learning models via specialized inference frameworks and serving patterns like batching and async inference.
Implement observability across the stack, including comprehensive logging, metrics, and alerting systems.
Architect distributed systems focusing on low latency, fault tolerance, and message queuing.
Triage and debug machine learning models in production to ensure consistent performance and reliability.
Manage embedding pipelines and integrate vector search capabilities to enhance application intelligence.




What You Bring

Extensive experience building and maintaining production-grade backend systems in languages such as Python, Go, or Java.
Strong understanding of system design principles, including distributed systems and data consistency.
Technical proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, caching layers, and message brokers like Kafka or Redis.
Proven experience shipping to production with built-in observability and monitoring.
Practical knowledge of machine learning libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, or HuggingFace for model integration and debugging.
Based in the US with authorization to work in the USA, no visas or sponsorships.




Nice to Haves

Experience with vector search engines and embedding pipelines.
Knowledge of advanced model serving patterns and asynchronous inference.
Prior experience in manufacturing, retail, or finance sectors.

About the job

Sé parte de la generación que está transformando la energía en México.

Algunas personas buscan un empleo. Otras buscan la oportunidad de dejar huella.

En ENGIE México trabajamos para acelerar la transición energética y construir soluciones que contribuyan a un futuro más sostenible. Detrás de cada proyecto, cada innovación y cada avance, hay personas que comparten una misma ambición: crear un impacto positivo para las próximas generaciones.

Como parte de una compañía global con más de 97,000 colaboradores en cinco continentes y una sólida trayectoria de casi tres décadas en México, tendrás la oportunidad de crecer, aprender y participar en proyectos que están redefiniendo el futuro de la energía. Si te motiva trabajar con propósito, asumir nuevos desafíos y formar parte de una organización que apuesta por el talento y la innovación, te invitamos a dar el siguiente paso.

Misión del puesto, Como Especialista de Relación con Comunidades, tendrás como misión gestionar la relación con comunidades dentro de las zonas asignadas, garantizando la prevención de riesgos sociales, la implementación efectiva de los planes de gestión social y el cumplimiento de la Política Social y de Responsabilidad Corporativa de ENGIE, la regulación nacional y los estándares internacionales, en su caso.

Tu impacto Contribuirás directamente a nuestra misión desempeñando funciones clave como:

Elaborar y proponer planes de gestión social mediante diagnósticos, análisis de riesgo y mapeo de actores.

Liderar la implementación del plan de gestión social, coordinando acciones con O&M y contratistas.

Gestionar riesgos sociales mediante su monitoreo, el establecimiento de alertas tempranas y su registro.

Gestionar el mecanismo de quejas, asegurando su atención, registro y seguimiento.

Coordinar consultores externos y supervisar sus entregables.

Requisitos


 Educación y Experiencia: Información no especificada en el job description. Información no especificada en el job description. 
 Habilidades Técnicas: Elaboración e implementación de planes de gestión social, diagnósticos, análisis de riesgo y mapeo de actores. Gestión de riesgos sociales, mecanismos de quejas y supervisión de entregables de consultores externos. 
 Competencias Clave: Información no especificada en el job description. 


¿Por qué podría interesarte? Este rol te permitirá:


 Un trabajo con propósito y un impacto real en la transición energética. 
 Oportunidades para aprender, innovar y desarrollar tu potencial. 
 Proyectos retadores que te permitirán crecer profesional y personalmente. 
 Un entorno diverso, inclusivo y colaborativo donde cada perspectiva cuenta. 
 El respaldo de una compañía global que apuesta por el talento, el bienestar y la construcción del futuro. 


En ENGIE, creemos que las grandes transformaciones comienzan con personas capaces de imaginar un futuro mejor y hacerlo realidad. Aquí, tu talento puede generar un impacto tangible, impulsar la transición energética y contribuir a proyectos que transforman la vida de millones de personas.

Desarrolla tu potencial, enfrenta nuevos desafíos y construye el futuro de la energía con nosotros.

Nuestro compromiso con la diversidad e inclusión

En ENGIE creemos que las grandes transformaciones nacen de la diversidad de ideas, experiencias y perspectivas. Por ello, promovemos una cultura inclusiva donde cada persona puede desarrollarse, aportar su talento y ser auténticamente ella misma. Estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y valoramos a cada persona por sus habilidades, potencial y trayectoria, sin distinción de raza, discapacidad, religión, género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, credo, edad o estado civil. Hoy construimos el futuro de la energía y buscamos personas que quieran generar impacto y crecer con propósito.

El futuro no se espera. Se construye. Construyámoslo juntos.
